summary: Idle-battle passes now apply only in a match with no human opponent (MatchState.IdleBattlePasses, set by solo practice against the bot and by bot batches, recorded in the replay): against the bot the engine passes for the human player and the bot alike; between two humans the pass stays the player's own or the engine's once they take Pass all battles.
